prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1437; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for a side impact collision at an intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a third-party vehicle that entered on a red signal, per the insured's statement. Police report requested. Claimant reports shoulder injury and is represented by counsel; all contact to go through the attorney's office.

Entry 2: Received written notice of representation from claimant's attorney. Letter of protection requested for medical bills. Liability appears clear based on the initial scene statements and the traffic camera footage requested from the municipality. Reserve set for bodily injury and property damage.

Entry 3: Spoke with the claimant's attorney's office. Claimant has begun treatment with an orthopedic provider for a rotator cuff strain and is scheduled for an MRI. Requested itemized medical records and prior treatment history for the right and left shoulder. Attorney indicated a demand package will follow once treatment concludes.

Entry 4: Vehicle inspection completed at the body shop. Damage consistent with a T-bone impact to the driver door, B-pillar, and rear quarter panel. Estimate received and under review. Rental coverage confirmed for the claimant's vehicle while repairs are pending. Subrogation notice sent to the at-fault carrier.

Entry 5: Received the MRI report and additional treatment notes from the claimant's provider. Shoulder findings are being reviewed by the medical reviewer against the mechanism of injury. Attorney's office notified that the file remains open pending the demand package. Diary set for follow-up in thirty days.
